response.original_title: Dinamogramas, el arte de la memoria
response.overview: A documentary that follows César Fioravanti, an 87-year-old sculptor and painter based in Temperley, as he lives through the isolation of the pandemic. Faced with the constant threat of the virus and the nearness of death, César works for much of the day: he designs and makes sculptures and paintings — among them his Dinamogramas — and organizes a group exhibition with artists of his generation.
response.title: Dinamogramas, el arte de la memoria
